title: Deep pothole on Begumpet main road
description: A large pothole near the Begumpet flyover is damaging vehicles and causing traffic jams every evening.

title: No water supply in Ameerpet colony
description: Residents of SBI Colony have had no water supply for two days. Water tanker has not arrived.

title: Garbage not collected for a week
description: Household waste is piling up on the street corner. Strong smell and stray dogs around the pile.

title: Streetlight not working on Madhapur road
description: Three consecutive streetlights near Madhapur HITEX junction are not working since last week. Dark stretch at night.

title: Sewage overflowing near Gachibowli junction
description: Manholes near the Gachibowli flyover are overflowing onto the road. Very bad smell and slippery surface.

title: Broken footpath outside Secunderabad railway station
description: Tiles on the footpath are broken and uneven. Elderly commuters find it difficult to walk.

title: Open manhole near Charminar market
description: Manhole cover is missing near the Charminar vegetable market. Children are at risk of falling in.

title: Stray dogs menace in Banjara Hills
description: A pack of stray dogs is chasing two-wheelers near Road No 12 every night. Dangerous for school children.

title: Power fluctuation in Jubilee Hills
description: Voltage fluctuation is damaging appliances in our apartment. Frequent tripping during evenings.

title: Water pipeline leak at Hitech City
description: Water pipeline is leaking near Cyber Towers and wasting water on the road for many days.

title: Garbage dump near Tarnaka bus stop
description: Open garbage dump right next to the bus stop. Commuters complain about the smell every day.

title: Damaged road at Dilsukhnagar flyover
description: Road surface near the Dilsukhnagar flyover has multiple craters and is dangerous for bikes.

title: Bus shelter damaged at Begumpet
description: The bus shelter near Begumpet metro has a broken roof and no bench. Commuters stand in the sun.

title: No streetlights on Ameerpet stretch
description: The entire Ameerpet cross road stretch is dark. Earlier complaints about theft at night.

title: Mosquito breeding at construction site
description: Stagnant water at an abandoned construction site in Kukatpally is breeding mosquitoes.

title: Drainage clogged in Madhapur lane
description: Storm water drain behind my house is completely clogged. Water enters the house during rain.

title: Auto overcharging near Gachibowli IT hub
description: Autos near the Gachibowli IT hub refuse to go by meter and charge double the fare.

title: Playground equipment broken in Secunderabad park
description: Swing chains in the children's park are broken and the slide is rusted. Kids cannot play safely.

title: Fallen tree across road in Banjara Hills
description: A tree fell across the service road near Kavuri Hills after the storm. Two lanes are blocked.

title: Water contamination reports in Jubilee Hills
description: Residents report the tap water is muddy and has a foul smell since two days.
